$description: Fliin tokens. Source of tokens.g.dart (fliin tokens). What has no DTCG type lives in $extensions dev.fliin.*.

color.$description: Colors of the Izydesk design system (handoff du 2026-10-31), blue accent. The shipped theme passes AA without exception; `fliin theme` adapts it to a brand.

surfaceOverlay.$description: Popover, menu, dialog, sheet: `page` in light mode, `surface` in dark mode.

accent.$description: The main action, focus and what is highlighted, nothing else. In dark mode, Izydesk `#3B76F6` becomes `#3B63F6`: white reaches 4.5:1 on it, even measured on rendered text.

accentPressed.$description: The pressed main button, Izydesk `focus` in light mode; in dark mode too, under white text.

accentSoft.$description: Soft background of a highlighted element, `surface-2`.

accentSoftPressed.$description: The pressed soft background, one step below `surface-2`.

onAccentSoft.$description: Text on a soft background: the text black, no more blue.

switchTrack.$description: Track of a switch that is off, `surface-2`.

onDangerSoft.$description: Danger text on a soft background: `danger` in dark mode; in light mode, darkened to 4.5:1 on `dangerSoftPressed`.

success.$description: Success, outside Izydesk: the canvas's muted hue.

warning.$description: Warning, outside Izydesk: the canvas's muted hue.

onStatusAction.$description: The action of a success or warning toast, on its background: Izydesk black.

field.$description: Background of a field: white and shadowed in light mode, `surface` in dark mode.

segment.$description: Thumb of the chosen segment: shadowed white on the `control` track.

scrim.$description: Scrim under a dialog or a sheet, opacity included; `size.scrimOpacity` scales it.

selected.$description: Everything checked, active or chosen: the accent.

link.$description: Text written in accent on a surface (back and bar actions, link): the focus ring steps, Izydesk `focus` in light mode (6.7:1 on `surface`), `#7AA7FF` in dark mode, where `#3B63F6` only has 3.93:1 on `page`.

button.$description: Button shape. No DTCG type carries an enumeration: the value lives in $extensions.
sm and md button in the rounded shape: already a capsule at 44 and 48 high. The default shape is pill; a finite radius keeps its effect with the radius scale and the rounded shape.

buttonLarge.$description: lg button in the rounded shape, a capsule at 56 high.

xxl.$description: Chips, tags, large badges: half their height, so the Izydesk pill (radius-pill), without a 9999 that the radius scale would not reduce.

size.$description: Control heights and list paddings per density; tap targets (48 Android, 44 iOS, 24 desktop: WCAG 2.2 §2.5.8) and the icon scale limit: invariants, not brand settings.

switchThumbInset.$description: Gap between the switch thumb and the edge of its track.

toggle.$description: Side of the checkbox and of the radio circle.

controlPressedScale.$description: Scale of the pressed switch and checkbox.

indicatorIcon.$description: Small indicator icon: chevrons (accordion, list-row, menu, select), menu check, search-field magnifier.

indicatorBox.$description: Box of an option's indicator (menu, select).

snugLineHeight.$description: `leading-snug` line height of secondary texts (popover, menu, select).

selectionHandleAndroid.$description: Side of the teardrop selection handle (Android, and desktop on touch).

selectionKnobIos.$description: Diameter of the iOS handle knob; their stem has the caret's width.

pressScaleReference.$description: Reference width of the press scale: a control of width w shrinks by (1 − pressedScale) × pressScaleReference / w.

disabledOpacity.$description: Opacity of a disabled control: the opacity: .5 of every disabled state of the Izydesk canvas (.btn, .link, .field, .switch, .seg, .tag).

hoverBrightness.$description: Brightness of a filled button (primary, danger, inverse) on hover: the filter: brightness(.92) of the Izydesk canvas.

pressedOverlayOpacity.$description: Opacity of the press overlay of a control without background (outline, ghost).

rippleDiagonal.$description: The reference diagonal of the press ripple (pressable-feedback).

pressHighlightOpacity.$description: Opacity of the default PressableFeedback overlay and ripple.

closeButton.$description: Side of the close button (close-button, h-8).

fieldInset.$description: Inset of the label, description and error in a field (px-1.5).

surfaceBorder.$description: Stroke around a surface (FlSurface): 0, set apart by its shadow; the “flat cards” preset gives it the size.border thickness.

popoverTravel.$description: Maximum slide of a popover entering from its anchor.

popoverOffset.$description: Gap between the popover or menu and its anchor.

selectOffset.$description: Gap between the select list and its trigger.

tooltipOffset.$description: Gap between the tooltip and its anchor, without an arrow.

overlayInset.$description: Margin of an anchored overlay to the screen edges (popover, menu, tooltip).

spring.$description: SpringDescription.withDampingRatio, mass 1: three number tokens per spring, marked dev.fliin.spring.

gentle.$description: Reanimated 4 default withSpring (mass 4, damping 120, stiffness 900): released dialog, toast stack, menu.

indicator.$description: Rotation of a chevron (accordion, select, sub-menu): mass 4, damping 140, stiffness 1000.

layout.$description: Height of an accordion opening or closing (the accordion's LinearTransition): mass 4, damping 140, stiffness 1600.

expand.$description: Expansion of a sub-menu: mass 3, damping 100, stiffness 950.

stack.$description: Height of the toast stack: mass 3, damping 100, stiffness 1200.

toastEnter.$description: Entrance of a toast (`FadeInUp.springify().mass(3)`): the Reanimated 4 default withSpring at mass 3, damping 120, stiffness 900.

pop.$description: Bouncing entrance: a counter badge, the liked heart, the icon of a toast settling (overshoot of about 20%).

roll.$description: Wheel of a rolling digit (counter, amount of a stat card): about 450 ms, a slight overshoot.

shake.$description: Shake of a rejected code or field: started from rest, it oscillates three times around zero.

easeInOutQuad.$description: The default withTiming curve in Reanimated: the press overlay.

easeInOutCubic.$description: Sweep of the indeterminate progress bar (`progress-bar.css`).

progressSweep.$description: One sweep of the indeterminate progress bar (`progress-bar.css`).

rippleMin.$description: Minimum duration of the press ripple (pressable-feedback).

ripple.$description: Press ripple over a 450 pt diagonal, proportional to the diagonal, between rippleMin and twice ripple.

headingFamily.$description: Font of headings (roles display, title1 to title3, heading1 to heading6). inherit: the text font.

controlSm.$description: Label of an sm control (text-sm, font-medium); tracking: the SF trak table at 14 pt.

monospace.$description: Font of `FlText` code: Menlo on iOS, monospace elsewhere.

$extensions.dev.fliin.notice: Colors, radii, typography and shadows from the Izydesk design system (ADR 0019). shadow.$description: Izydesk shadows: `overlay` for what floats, `surface` and `field` very soft in light mode; `glow` and `dangerGlow` are the halo of the main and destructive buttons, in the accent and danger colors; `thumb` lifts the switch and slider thumb off its track.
